title: feat(auth): make --token logins work with remotes like ssh.gitlab.gnome.org
description:
## Description

On `main`, after `glab auth login --hostname gitlab.gnome.org --stdin` in a clone whose remote is on `ssh.gitlab.gnome.org`, repository commands fail with "none of the git remotes configured for this repository point to a known GitLab host", because the login saved no `ssh_host`. This MR does item 2 from https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/work_items/8707#note_4138099527: detect and save `ssh_host` during a non-interactive login inside a clone.

- `--token` and `--stdin` logins ignored `--ssh-hostname`. They now save it, as other logins already do.
- Without the flag, non-interactive logins to a self-managed instance look up each SSH remote's project on that instance, and save the remote's host only if the project's SSH clone URL (`ssh_url_to_repo`) uses it. A remote of another instance is therefore skipped, because its project is missing on this instance or has a different SSH host. These read-only lookups send the paths of all SSH remotes in the clone to the instance being logged in to, including remotes on other hosts.
- Passing `--ssh-hostname` skips these lookups, and `glab auth login --help` now says so. With `GLAB_DEBUG=1`, login logs why each lookup failed.
- An existing `ssh_host` is kept. Interactive logins are unchanged.

When it saves a detected host, login says so:

```plaintext
✓ Set the SSH host of gitlab.gnome.org to ssh.gitlab.gnome.org, taken from this repository's remotes.
✓ Logged in as johan.walles
```

For a login done before cloning, the error from !4271 says how to set `ssh_host`.

## Related Issues

Closes #8707.

## How has this been tested?

New table test `Test_tokenLogin_savesSSHHost` covers the flag, a confirmed remote, a lookup that uses `--api-protocol`, and nothing saved for an HTTPS remote, an unconfirmed or missing project, or an existing `ssh_host`. The three cases that save fail against `main`. `Test_deviceLogin_savesSSHHost` covers `--ssh-hostname` and the detection in a `--device` login, and fails if that flow's `saveSSHHost` call is removed.

Also:

- In a clone of `GNOME/gnome-settings-daemon` with an empty config, `glab auth login --hostname gitlab.gnome.org --stdin` saved no `ssh_host` on `main`, and `glab issue list` failed. With this change it saves `ssh.gitlab.gnome.org`, and `glab issue list` lists the issues.
- `glab auth login --hostname gitlab.example.invalid --token <fake> --ssh-hostname ssh.gitlab.example.invalid` saved no `ssh_host` on glab 1.128.0, and saves it with this change.
- `make test-changed`, `golangci-lint` and `comment-overlap` pass.

Non-interactive `--web` logins go through the same code as `--device`, but no test covers them.
